assessor.conflict_notes: The fixture author and assessor are fictional; this example is not independent validation.

target.name: Synthetic Glass Map claim-review workflow
target.intended_use: Demonstrate the OOVS assessment data shape using only fictional public-review material.
target.sample_method: All five nodes, three relationships, and the single fictional claim in the synthetic graph were reviewed.

results.rationale: The synthetic plan records a fictional purpose, scope, owner, review point, and stop condition.
The fixture permits only bundled synthetic records and excludes live or personal-data collection.
Synthetic source, document, claim, event, action, time, method, and evidence references are traceable.
The fictional claim is visibly single-origin, its evidence chain is explicit, and no repetition is counted.
The claim is held at moderate confidence awaiting corroboration, and it triggers review rather than consequential action.
The synthetic relationships distinguish observed source linkage, analytic support, and the review action.
The fixture contains no real person, victim, live case, restricted source, or sensitive personal information.
No AI system collects, transforms, ranks, links, summarises, analyses, or drafts content in this deterministic fixture.
The synthetic output is TLP:CLEAR, explicitly caveated, and limited to review of a fictional event.
The fixture records an owner, a separate review action, and a correction path for demonstration purposes.

limitations: This is a synthetic schema example, not evidence that an organisation or real workflow meets OOVS.
The fixture does not test legal authority, live sources, personal data, operational security, scale, or high-consequence decisions.
A self-authored example cannot demonstrate independent assessor agreement.
disclaimer: An OOVS assessment records a defined scope and result; it is not certification or a determination of legal compliance.
